Throw urns at enemies or enemies into urns; charge enemies into spike walls or snake pits.

9 battles across 3 acts with bosses, before the final encounter. Do not silently treat the final encounter as one of the nine or a fourth act.
10 increasingly difficult levels announced; this source does not name all ten.

8 different beasts; unlockable variants can differ in stats/abilities and cosmetics. The post does not enumerate all eight or all variants.

Alongside Steam: PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Game Pass for Xbox and Windows PC.
Oct 15, 2026 at 10:00 AM PDT / 17:00 UTC, equivalent to Oct 16 01:00 Singapore. This explains the Steam local-date difference.
Carthage → Germania → Rome. Full game has three arena chapters.

Makes allies often attack if the afflicted player gets too close.
Forces locking a new skill every second level and buying an item at every shop.
Camera follows a particular ally; +10% damage while that ally looks at the afflicted player. A pre-launch stated value, not measured launch-build data.
Separation Anxiety, Bad Vibrations, Butterfingers, Narcissism, Gambling Problem, Nerve Damage are named as a guessing prompt. Effects remain unspecified in this source.
July 16 10am PT through July 19 11:59pm PT; announced as the only pre-launch preview of Act 2.

Germania boss has unpredictable jumps and ground-slam attacks.
Between acts, surgeon manages afflictions or offers body augmentations granting skills; every procedure has a cost. No complete price table disclosed.
24 combined new skills, afflictions and items; not 24 in each category. Also a new axe and two difficulty options.
Beta: causes hallucinated weapons to appear in the arena.

Beta only: pays 100 coins if held through a fight survived without taking damage. Do not assume launch payout.

Updated demo adds a ranged bow, with friendly-fire warning.
Updated demo permits executions on downed foes for crowd approval, and throwing severed limbs or heads as improvised weapons.
Archers fire from range; wrestlers pin gladiators until a teammate rescues them; defensive swordsmen attack behind shields.
Demo Twitch integration lets chat vote which affliction potion is drunk between rounds.

gaps.summary: Launch count 8 is verified, but only Rhino and Ibex are explicitly named as playable beasts in the inspected announcement bodies. No complete eight-name roster, concrete variant names, beast starting skills, stat tables or unlock thresholds found. Asset folder labels are retained only as metadata.

Named Beta skill Untouchable and Beta item Priceless Vase have effects and values. Named weapons sword/spear/mace/flail/bow/axe are established across dated versions. Full 70+ skill list, 40+ item list, weapon damage/cooldowns/shop prices not supplied by inspected text.

Annoying/Impulsive/Infatuated have launch-preview effects; Psychosis is Beta. Six Oct names have no disclosed effects. Historical broken toe/dislocated shoulder/punctured lung and generic missing eye/limp/hallucinations are version-scoped; no full 70+ table.
Launch has 10 levels; only four Demo names supplied. July Beta adds two unnamed options. Complete launch names and modifiers unverified.
Three launch chapters, named Goliath and Praefectus, unnamed rhino-mounted first boss established. Full boss attack/stage/stat tables and comprehensive trap/enemy roster not supplied.

Controller support and at least one gamepad for same-screen co-op verified. Exact keyboard/mouse support, keybindings, split input combinations and max supported controller arrangements not explicitly documented in inspected sources.
Recommended CPU/GPU/RAM/storage figures are not given. No Windows minimum disk-space or DirectX version in inspected store section; do not invent them.

All launch entries are pre-release official statements as observed before unlock, not launch-build measurements. Beta 6-second Untouchable / 100-coin Vase and 2025 trainer reps/shield behavior must not be generalized to launch.
Other media-pack folder internals, screenshots, renders, trailers and gameplay footage not individually reviewed. No facts inferred from unseen image/video contents.

facts.applicable_version: General Steam Cloud; current official documentation, no client build specified
facts.fact: Configured Cloud files are replicated after game exit and downloaded to another computer before launch; Steam normally synchronizes before and after each session.
facts.caveat: Only files selected by the developer are covered; this is not continuous arbitrary mid-run saving.

facts.applicable_version: General Steam Cloud; current official documentation, no client build specified
facts.fact: Developers control which files/settings use Steam Cloud; a Cloud badge does not identify the precise covered save files.

facts.applicable_version: General Steam Cloud; current official documentation, no client build specified
facts.fact: A conflict can occur when local and cloud copies differ after unsynchronized changes. Compare timestamps with actual gameplay progress before choosing a version.
facts.caveat: Do not automatically choose cloud or blindly choose the newest timestamp.

facts.applicable_version: General Steam Cloud; current official documentation, no client build specified
facts.fact: Offline play cannot synchronize until Steam is online again, and can cause conflicts.

facts.applicable_version: General Steam Cloud; current official documentation, no client build specified
facts.fact: Steam recommends resolving synchronization failures before starting the game; ignoring the warning can cause local/cloud conflicts and lost progress.

facts.applicable_version: General Steam Cloud; current official documentation, no client build specified
facts.fact: If progress is missing on another computer, the original computer may still hold unsynchronized progress; Steam suggests checking synchronization there.
facts.caveat: Recovery is not guaranteed; Steam Support cannot restore lost saves or resolve a user’s choice of conflicting copies.

facts.applicable_version: General Steam Cloud; current official documentation, no client build specified
facts.fact: Steam supports cross-operating-system Cloud integration, but not all games implement it.
facts.caveat: Does not establish Windows/macOS save compatibility for Chained Beasts or any console cross-save.

facts.applicable_version: Steam app 3569420 store, pre-unlock observation
facts.fact: The inspected game store lists the Steam Achievements feature; the badge target is a general store category search, not the game’s achievement list.
facts.caveat: Actual achievement names, counts, conditions, percentages and hidden entries remain unknown.

facts.applicable_version: Participating Xbox Play Anywhere digital editions on Xbox console and Windows 10/11 PC; current en-US FAQ
facts.fact: Xbox Play Anywhere applies to eligible digital games bought from Xbox Store, Windows Store or participating retailers’ digital codes, with no additional platform charge.
facts.caveat: Not a disc entitlement or a Steam/PS5/Switch purchase entitlement; subscription access is not a purchase.

facts.applicable_version: Participating Xbox Play Anywhere digital editions on Xbox console and Windows 10/11 PC; current en-US FAQ
facts.fact: Sign into the same Xbox Live/Microsoft account to download the eligible purchase on supported devices.

facts.applicable_version: Participating Xbox Play Anywhere digital editions on Xbox console and Windows 10/11 PC; current en-US FAQ
facts.fact: Xbox-saved game progress carries between the supported Xbox and Windows PC editions, including saves, add-ons and achievements.
facts.caveat: This is the platform program guarantee, not a tested Chained Beasts transfer or Steam Cloud bridge.

facts.applicable_version: Participating Xbox Play Anywhere digital editions on Xbox console and Windows 10/11 PC; current en-US FAQ
facts.fact: Bought or earned content for owned Play Anywhere games carries across supported devices, including add-ons, Season Passes, consumables and in-game unlocks.
facts.caveat: Do not extend this entitlement to other storefront editions.

facts.applicable_version: Participating Xbox Play Anywhere digital editions on Xbox console and Windows 10/11 PC; current en-US FAQ
facts.fact: The same game cannot be signed into simultaneously on multiple supported devices.

facts.applicable_version: Participating Xbox Play Anywhere digital editions on Xbox console and Windows 10/11 PC; current en-US FAQ
facts.fact: A Play Anywhere game has a single shared set of Gamerscore and achievements rather than awarding them twice across Xbox and Windows PC.
facts.caveat: Not proof that Steam achievements share unlocks or progress.

boundaries: Platform help is general guidance, not a Chained Beasts-specific recovery fix.
Steam Cloud does not establish the game’s exact save files, checkpoint timing or console cross-save.
Xbox Play Anywhere rights/progress must not be extended to Steam, PS5 or Switch.
No achievement endpoints were guessed and no unpublished data was bypassed.
